notes.title: Second update!
notes.notes:
This is a small update to fix a kinda-big bug!

Fixed the ranger equipment generation bug in which new equipment stats would rise faster and faster.
Balanced the ranger equipment to give a bit less damage and way less attack speed.

As always, if there's any problem, don't doubt about telling me. :)

notes.title: First Update is now live!
notes.notes:
This update fixes a few tiny problems to improve your experience. Here's the full changelog:

Fixed a typo in Mord's library entry description.
Fixed a grammatical error in the Common Heart item description.
Not showing "died in" when beating the game anymore.
Fixed spawn of two bosses that sometimes didn't appear and required re-entering their room.
Tutorial now fades correctly when in-game.


Enjoy!
